paper_metadata.title: Mechanical properties and wear behaviors of lightweight Al3Ti-based medium-entropy alloys at elevated temperatures

evidence.quote: Al3Ti-based medium-entropy alloys (MEAs) with improved high-temperature mechanical properties and wear resistance were fabricated using arc melting method via alloying Al3Ti with various amounts of Cr, Mn, Fe and Cu elements.
The microstructures of the fabricated Al3Ti-based lightweight alloys are shown in Figs. 3–6.
an Al-matrix composite reinforced with 30 wt% SiC particles (referred to as Al/SiCp) was used as a reference material.
For the lightweight alloys, the wear resistance initially increases with the addition of alloying elements but then declines with further increasing the addition of the alloying elements.
